note: Hours Minutes Seconds defines the core Field API plugin `hour_minutes_seconds` (int seconds storage), widget `hour_minutes_seconds_default`, and four formatters: hour_minutes_seconds_default_formatter, hour_minutes_seconds_countdown_formatter, hour_minutes_seconds_natural_language_formatter, hour_minutes_seconds_iso_duration_formatter. Conversion service id hours_minutes_seconds.hour_minutes_seconds (secondsToFormatted/formattedToSeconds/toIso8601/fromIso8601/toArray). No configure route, no permissions, no Drush, no custom plugin manager. Field-instance settings min/max (seconds); widget setting `format`. Medium cases read real field config (min/max) and real form-display widget format; hard cases set the view-display formatter (ISO / countdown), all verified against live core.entity_*_display config.

evals.prompt: How does the Drupal hours_minutes_seconds field type store its value in the database, and what is the field type's machine id?
evals.expected_output: The field type id is `hour_minutes_seconds`; it stores a single column `value` as a (nullable, signed) integer representing the total number of seconds. Negative durations are supported. Widgets/formatters convert to and from that integer.

evals.prompt: Which display formatters does the hours_minutes_seconds module provide for its duration field? Name the one that outputs an ISO 8601 duration and the one that shows a live countdown.
evals.expected_output: Four formatters: hour_minutes_seconds_default_formatter (with optional live count-up timer), hour_minutes_seconds_countdown_formatter (live countdown), hour_minutes_seconds_natural_language_formatter, and hour_minutes_seconds_iso_duration_formatter (outputs e.g. PT2H30M45S).

evals.prompt: In code, how do I convert a raw number of seconds into an ISO 8601 duration (and a formatted h:mm:ss string) using the hours_minutes_seconds module? Which service and methods?

On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an Hours/Minutes/Seconds field named field_hms_known with minimum and maximum duration constraints configured. Inspect the live field configuration and state the min and max values (in seconds).
evals.expected_output: field.field.node.article.field_hms_known has settings min='60' and max='3600' (seconds). Read via `drush cget field.field.node.article.field_hms_known settings`.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has an Hours/Minutes/Seconds field named field_hms_fmt. Inspect the live default form display and state the input format string configured on its widget.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_hms_fmt component (widget hour_minutes_seconds_default) has settings.format = 'd:h:mm:ss'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an Hours/Minutes/Seconds field field_hms_task. Configure the default view display so that this field is rendered with the module's ISO 8601 Duration formatter, with the human-readable label option enabled (so the value is wrapped in a <time> element). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_hms_task component has type 'hour_minutes_seconds_iso_duration_formatter' with settings.visible_label = true.

evals.prompt: There is a duration field called field_hms_show on Article pages. I want it to show as a live countdown timer that ticks down to zero when someone views the page. Please set that up on this site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_hms_show component is set to type 'hour_minutes_seconds_countdown_formatter'.
